messages.author: 66d476f73319ee2a
messages.subject: Mediation CFA Bootstrapping Standard Errors
parts:
I'm running some CFA models DWLS estimator with mediation and am struggling to get standard errors when I add additional direct relationships to the independent variable. The first model listed below generates the outputs as expected, the second does not generate standard errors, etc - I get NAs in their place. I had noticed a couple of posts here suggesting bootstrapping for mediation in CFA/SEM but they didn't say it was required. The bootstrapped se versions run, but I only get a few successful draws so I wondered other methods would also work before I conclude that there are just some basic issues with the extended models I have come up with. 

MoralCheckingModel3 <- 'intentioncheck =~ Q9_10 + Q9_11 + Q9_12 + Q9_13 + Q9_3;
                                      attcheck =~ Q17_1 + Q17_5 + Q17_4 + Q18_2 + Q18_5 + Q18_3 + Q18_7
                                      wastemoral =~ Q22_7 + Q22_8 + Q22_9 + Q22_10 + Q22_11
                                      intentioncheck ~ b*attcheck
                                      intentioncheck ~ c*wastemoral
                                       #indirect
                                       attcheck ~ a*wastemoral
                                       #indirect effect
                                       ab := a*b
                                       #total effect
                                       total := c + (a*b)'

MoralCheckingModel4 <- 'intentioncheck =~ Q9_10 + Q9_11 + Q9_12 + Q9_13 + Q9_3
                                      attcheck =~ Q17_1 + Q17_5 + Q17_4 + Q18_2 + Q18_5 + Q18_3 + Q18_7
                                      wastemoral =~ Q22_7 + Q22_8 + Q22_9 + Q22_10 + Q22_11
                                      pbccheck =~ Q15_1 + Q15_2 + Q15_12 + Q15_4 + Q15_5
                                      intentioncheck ~ b*attcheck
                                      intentioncheck ~ c*wastemoral
                                       intentioncheck ~ pbccheck
                                      #indirect
                                      attcheck ~ a*wastemoral
                                      #indirect effect
                                      ab := a*b
                                     #total effect
                                     total := c + (a*b)'

Each model is run with:
modelfitobject <- cfa(model =,  data =, std.lv = T, estimator = "DWLS", ordered=c("Q9_10", "Q9_11" etc. ))
summary(modelfit, fit.measures=TRUE)

Many thanks

Bethan
